{{Top}}
'''Cranker root''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. The root was edible, and the dining establishment, [[BanthaQuik!]], included the roots in one of their popular dishes, [[Rodian Platter]]. The platter consisted entirely of deeply-oiled cranker roots.<ref name="DH">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
